# Elimix School Management System (Mavora SRMS)
> Developed by Mavora Technologies (https://mavoratechnologies.com)

## Product Overview
Elimix is a cloud-native, multi-tenant school management system built for primary schools, secondary academies, colleges, and universities in Kenya and supported markets.

## Verified Core Modules
- Multi-Tenant Security & Governance: Partitioned PostgreSQL database schemas per institution, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and immutable audit logs.
- Student Information System (SIS): Student admissions, class allocations, attendance tracking, medical records, transfers, withdrawals, and discipline records.
- Academic & CBC Administration: Curriculum structure, departments, subjects, teacher allocations, lesson plans, timetables, CBC rubrics, examinations, and branded report cards.
- School Fees & Finance: Termly fee structures, student invoices, payment recording, reconciliation, fee statements, defaulter tracking, and income-expenditure reports.
- Campus Operations & E-Learning: LMS courses, quizzes and resources, parent communication portals, library circulation, hostel management, transport fleet routing, HR payroll, and procurement.
